StampDutyExemptDec.HelpText:
Please note:

Before selecting the NSW small business insurance stamp duty exemption, ensure you have a current small business declaration in the approved format (as determined by the Chief Commissioner of State Revenue) from the client on file.

By selecting the exemption on behalf of the insured, you declare that you are appropriately authorised and knowledgeable to obtain the declaration.

This declaration must confirm eligibility for the exemption and be retained for a minimum of 5 years. These declarations are subject to audit. Ensure you can provide a copy upon request. Non-compliance may result in penalties and affect the validity of the exemption.

Document.DisclaimerText:
*Preferred repairer excess rebate of $200 (Comprehensive cover type only - Refer PDS)

In addition to the Basic Excess, the following excesses may apply for a given claim;

  • Age excess of $850 where the driver of the vehicle is under the age of 21 at the time of the claim
  • Age excess of $750 where the driver of the vehicle is between the age of 21 and 25 at the time of the claim
  • Inexperienced driver excess of $750 where the driver of the vehicle is aged over 25 but has less than 2 years driving experience
  • Hydraulic lifting or tipping excess of $1,000
  • Convertible roof or open top excess of $500

If you do not provide us with the details of the driver of your vehicle involved in the accident within a reasonable period of time (and in any event no later than 30 days) following the accident, the excess will be calculated as:

  • the basic excess; and
  • any hydraulic lifting or tipping mechanism or convertible roof or open top excesses which may be applicable to your claim; and
  • the higher of:
    • the age excess; or
    • the inexperienced driver excess.

See the PDS for the standard policy terms, conditions, limits and exclusions.

Excess.HintText: See 'i' for more information about minimum excesses.
Excess.HelpText:
Please note that our minimum excesses are as follows. If needed, please enter a value equal to or greater than the applicable minimum. If a value is entered below the required minimum the quote will be declined.

  • Sedan, station wagon, 4WD, utility, van or other goods carrying vehicle - $900
    (higher minimums apply to vehicles over $100K. This min excess value will be auto displayed)
  • Food/Drinks Trailer - $1000
  • Trailer - Box / Boat / Horse / Luggage - $500
  • Dog Washing-Grooming Trailer - $500
  • Trailer - Other - $500
  • Mobile Plant - $800
  • Vehicle used for Food Truck / Trailer / Van - $1000
  • Vehicle used for Courier or delivery/removalist services or Courier/Delivery/Road Freight occupation - $2500.
